item.title: Grid operator declares emergency as heat wave strains network
item.author: desk@energy.example.com (Example Energy Desk)
item.content:encoded:
The regional grid operator declared a level-two emergency on Sunday evening as a sustained heat wave pushed electricity demand to a record high.

Operators invoked emergency protocols for the first time in four years, asking industrial customers to curtail consumption. Reserve margins fell below six percent for three consecutive hours.

The operator said rotating outages were avoided but that the network remains under stress until temperatures drop.
